chapter: Postwar Chicago, Janis and De Paris
title: Wilbur De Paris and Bob Wilber
summary: Moore played with De Paris later at Ryan's, and with Wilber in Boston in 1948.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: All right. Now we're in, let's say, the late Forties. You've been with Bechet, you've been with Art Hodes. Did you play a little bit with Wilbur DeParis before 1950, or was this later?
Later, when we all started at the Onyx Club... no, Jimmmy Ryan's.
Jimmy Ryan's, okay. And how about Bob Wilbur? You played with Bob Wilbur in 1948?
In '48...? I did some work with Bob Wilbur at the Savoy in Boston.
